lede: From making history to making art for Psydrip, Raiyan's work carries the love-and-unity spirit of the psychedelic scene.
body:
"Pushing boundaries is what Raiyan does best." That's how B-POP Tags introduced [@lunith.void](https://www.instagram.com/lunith.void/), an artist whose work, as our caption put it, represents "the psychedelic culture of love and unity". If you're looking for psychedelic art in Dhaka, he's a name to know.

## Psychedelic art in Dhaka's rave community

The caption credits Raiyan with everything "from making history to creating art" for [@psydrip.dhk](https://www.instagram.com/psydrip.dhk/), and signs off with thanks and a reminder to "keep raving hard". Tagged #dhakagram and #psy, the post places his work in the city's psychedelic and rave circles.

## A glimpse of his art

The carousel is labelled "Collected via IG" and "Glimpse of his art". Its preview frame shows a collage where a portrait is layered over a newspaper page printed in Arabic script, framed in hot pinks and reds. Above it sits an illustrated eye cradled by two hands in purple and green, a fitting motif for the subject.

Find more visual artists in [Art & Fashion](topic:art). For the sound that goes with the visuals, see the [Omnigroove DJ workshop with Psytaraa](post:omnigroove-dj-workshop-dhaka), [DJ Shimmerie and Dhaka's underground parties](post:dj-shimmerie-dhaka-underground-parties) and [OMDG's role in Bangladesh's rave revolution](post:omdg-dhaka-rave-revolution). More on the [B-POP Tags home page](home:).

[See the original post on Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/p/DclGLm8moU4/)
